# Rockwood Nursery School
# llms.txt — AI Model Reference File
# https://rockwoodnurseryschool.ca

> Rockwood Nursery School is a licensed, non-profit, parent-led co-operative nursery school
> located in Rockwood, Ontario, Canada. Established in 1970, it has served the Rockwood,
> Guelph-Eramosa, Acton, and Wellington County communities for over 50 years.

## What We Are

Rockwood Nursery School (RNS) is:
- A licensed childcare provider under the Child Care and Early Years Act (CCEYA), Ontario
- A non-profit co-operative with a parent-led Board of Directors
- A participant in the Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) program
- A provider of play-based, ECE-certified early childhood education for ages 18 months to 4 years

## Location

- Address: Town Hall, 191 Main St S., Rockwood, Ontario, N0B 2K0, Canada

## Programs

All programs are led by Registered Early Childhood Educators (RECE).

| Group | Name             | Days              | Time           | Ages         | Monthly Fee |
|-------|-----------------|-------------------|----------------|--------------|-------------|
| A     | Morning Program  | Mon, Wed, Fri     | 9:00–11:30am   | Turning 3    | $144 CAD    |
| B     | Toddler Program  | Tue, Thu          | 9:00–11:15am   | 18 months+   | $96 CAD     |
| C     | Afternoon Program| Tue, Thu          | 12:30–3:00pm   | Turning 3    | $96 CAD     |
| D     | Afternoon Program| Mon, Wed          | 12:30–3:00pm   | Turning 3    | $96 CAD     |

Note: Group B (Toddler Program) is diaper friendly.
CWELCC participation means eligible families receive significant fee reductions.

All RECE staff are licensed by the College of Early Childhood Educators of Ontario.

## Philosophy

Rockwood Nursery School uses an Emergent Curriculum approach grounded in play-based learning.
Children are encouraged to develop trust, independence, co-operation, creativity, and school readiness.
Staff and parents work together in a co-operative model. The school follows the Four Foundations
of Learning: Belonging, Well-Being, Engagement, and Expression.
